title: Probing quantum spin liquids with multiple quantum coherences
summary: Quantum simulators are beginning to prepare long-sought phases of matter that remain difficult to realize cleanly in materials. Yet identifying such phases remains a major challenge when their defining properties are inherently non-local and cannot be captured by conventional local measurements. Here we establish multiple-quantum coherences (MQCs) as phase-sensitive diagnostics for gapped $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quantum spin liquids.
